title: Orchid Incorporated, Form 941-X correcting scenario 1

status.note: Composed and schema-valid offline (AtsScenarioComposeTest). Send after ATS reopens on 2026-10-13, and only if Pyramos will file 941-X corrections in production (Pub 5078 section 2.5.1).

summary: A Form 941-X that corrects Orchid's Q1 2026 Form 941 from scenario 1. The original return underreported wages, social security wages and Medicare wages by $1,500 each, and federal income tax withheld by $150. It uses the adjusted-return process (line 1), not the claim process, and $379.50 of additional tax is owed.
tests: Return being corrected: Form 941, quarter 1, calendar year 2026, errors discovered 05/21/2026
Part 1 line 1, the adjusted employment tax return process (underreported tax). Line 2, the claim, is unchecked.
Part 2 line 3 (W-2/W-2c filed) and line 4a (employees repaid) certifications
Correction columns: 1 corrected, 2 originally reported, 3 difference, 4 tax correction
Line 8 social security correction at 0.124 ($186.00) and line 12 Medicare correction at 0.029 ($43.50)
Line 23 sum of column 4 ($379.50) and line 27 total amount owed ($379.50)
notes: Column 2 (originally reported) matches scenario 1's 941 exactly: $1,000 wages, $100 withheld, $1,000 social security and Medicare wages.

The IRS PDF has 4 pages, although page 1 says to complete all five. Page 5 (Part 4 explanation, Part 5 signature) is missing, so CorrectionsExplanationTxt is written by us and cannot be checked against the PDF.
Page 1 of the PDF enters calendar year 2026, but the running header on pages 2-4 shows 2025. The client body uses 2026, which matches the tax period.
The address here is '1st Test St', while scenario 1 uses '1st Test Street'. Each fixture follows its own PDF.
